Dunn & Acosta LLP
Conroe, TX
Phone 713-555-4341
Settlement Demand
11 May 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1261 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Ashley Duncan in connection with the motor vehicle collision
that occurred on 24 Jul 2023. Our client was traveling in the right lane when the
insured vehicle changed lanes without adequate warning and sideswiped the driver's
side of our client's car. The impact forced our client's vehicle towrad the shoulder
and caused the airbag to deploy.
Our client suffered a concussion as a result of the collision. Since the accident, our
client has experienced persistent headaches, dizziness, light sensitivity, and
difficulty concentrating. Treating physicians have restricted our client from work and
driving for an extended period, and ongoing care, including neurological follow-up and
physical therapy, remains necessary.
The police report documents the lane change as the cause of the collision, and the
insured driver acknowledged at the scene that he did not see our client's vehicle.
Liability is clear under the applicable traffic statutes.
Accordingly, we demand payment of $120,000.00 to resolve all bodily injury claims
arising from this loss. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of
this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are
prepared to file suit without further notice.
Expert review: Anthony Davis, neurologist
Sincerely,
Candice Smith
Dunn & Acosta LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
